intro: Voice Relay speaks creator-written alert acknowledgements through one approved Streamer.bot Speaker.bot action. Viewer-written messages are separately opt-in, filtered, bounded, and never retained.

sections.title: 1. Speaker.bot setup
sections.notice: Create a Voice Alias in Speaker.bot first, enter that exact alias here, connect Speaker.bot inside Streamer.bot, approve only Speak, then test before enabling live speech.

sections.title: 2. Choose what may be spoken
sections.notice: Thank-you text and viewer-written text are separate. Follow, like-milestone, and public-chat speech start off; viewer alert messages are all off until explicitly selected.

sections.title: 3. Thank-you wording
sections.notice: Available tokens: {actor}, {amount}, {currency}, {quantity}, {itemName}, {tier}, {metric}, and {value}. Viewer messages are appended only for events selected above.

sections.title: 4. Financial and spam thresholds
sections.notice: Use thresholds to keep small repeated events visual-only. StreamBridge's alert aggregation remains authoritative for combined visual alerts.

sections.title: 6. Emergency controls
sections.notice: Pause, Resume, and Stop control future StreamBridge requests. Use Speaker.bot Clear Pending or Stop Speaking to immediately clear audio already queued inside Speaker.bot.
